neighbours.label: the first piece of a split verb meaning 'consider' (re|cons|iders, CON|SIDER, betr|achten, cont|emplates, расс|мотреть), which predicts the rest of the consider-verb; the same pieces inside other words stay quiet
fire: Each spring the board reconsiders the budget after the audit is published.
After a long talk with her coach, the young striker reconsiders her transfer.
Faced with new evidence, the judge reconsiders the earlier ruling on bail.
When prices fall, a cautious investor often reconsiders the whole plan.
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS: PLEASE CONSIDER THE NOISE LEVEL AFTER TEN.
FINAL WARNING. WE ARE CONSIDERING LEGAL ACTION IF THE BILL IS NOT PAID.
Wenn man die Zahlen genauer betrachtet, sieht das Bild anders aus.
Die Forscherin wollte den Fall noch einmal aus der Nähe betrachten.
quiet: Each spring the board reconstructs the budget after the audit is published.
After a long talk with her coach, the young striker reconciles with her rival.
Faced with new evidence, the judge fears the runoff may contaminate the well.
When prices fall, a cautious investor often rebalances the whole plan.
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS: PLEASE CONSUME LESS WATER DURING THE DROUGHT.
FINAL WARNING. WE ARE CONSTRUCTING A NEW FENCE ALONG THE ROAD.
Wenn man die Kirche betraten hatte, wurde es plötzlich still.
Старик хотел ещё раз рассказать внукам эту старую историю.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.6 on ' re'/'cons', ' CON' or ' betr' when the word is a consider-verb; the same pieces in CONSTRUCT, betraten, contaminate below 0.1
